metadata.exg_method: ExG = 2G - R - B; min-max normalized; Otsu threshold; 3x3 opening/closing

per_tree_vari_heatmaps.mask: finite VARI pixels intersected with the current ExG mask across each full tree bounding-box crop; quartile colors overlay the ExG-segmented RGB crop
per_tree_vari_heatmaps.color_scale: four shared quartile bins using detected-tree mean VARI values; cutoff values are the pooled 25th, 50th, and 75th percentiles; colors blend over RGB at 0.72 alpha

metadata.zone_boost_formula: Bi=max(0, 1-V_input/Vref)*zone_confidence; Vref/P25 use valid reference-zone means (zone factor >= configured threshold), falling back to all valid zones if none qualify; if P95-P25 gap <= configured cutoff, V_input=P25 for every zone, otherwise V_input=each zone mean
metadata.zone_specific_boost_formula: B_zone=max(0, 1-zone_mean_vari/Vref)*zone_confidence; shown for comparison even when P25 blanket mode is applied
metadata.zone_mean_vari_percentile_rank_definitio: 100 × number of valid zone means less than or equal to this zone mean ÷ number of valid zones; empirical rank within this image only
metadata.fertilizer_boost_formula: Additional nutrient supplement: Mg_i=Bi*Mg_max; N_i=Bi*N_max; annual zone supplement kg=annual supplement kg/ha*zone area ha
metadata.lowest_zone_min_vari_flag_definition: Each zone tied for the lowest finite min_vari is flagged for review; this is an image-screening cue, not a diagnosis.
metadata.zone_confidence_rule: zone_factor=min(1,sqrt(tree_count/full_tree_count))*min(1,leaf_pixel_ratio/full_leaf_ratio); zone_local_confidence=clamp(flight_confidence*zone_factor,floor,1); optional ZONE_CONFIDENCE_BY_ID values override zone_local_confidence; overall_field_confidence=clamp(tree_count_weighted_mean(zone_local_confidence),floor,1); all zone boosts use the single overall_field_confidence
zone_confidence_run_flags: flight confidence (L6) not assessed; DEFAULT_ZONE_CONFIDENCE is used as the flight factor
metadata.fertilizer_output_scope: VARI-scaled additional elemental nutrient supplement and its product-mass equivalent; full maintenance fertilizer schedule is not included unless a separate approved product base rate is configured
metadata.ground_area_source: detected tree count × configured spacing² (active default)
metadata.zone_area_formula: zone_area_ha = detected_tree_count × spacing_m² ÷ 10,000; explicit per-zone or uniform areas override this estimate
metadata.vari_pixel_filter: Only finite VARI pixels with non-zero denominator inside ExG mask are included
metadata.zone_grouping: Approximate image-row clustering; columns use fixed spatial bins based on median within-row tree spacing so missing detections do not shift subsequent bins; zone bbox encloses detected member boxes only
metadata.coordinate_system: Pixel coordinates use origin (0,0) at top-left; bbox x1,y1 inclusive-ish and x2,y2 exclusive crop boundary; center_point and center provide (x, y) coordinates for each zone based on the white-separator zoning image. normalized_xyxy and normalized_x/y values are divided by original image width/height.
limitations: ExG is a heuristic vegetation mask and may include weeds or omit shaded palm leaves.
Zone confidence is a heuristic from tree count and ExG leaf-pixel coverage; notebook parameters marked GUESS require calibration against field observations.
Zone rectangles are generated from spatial grouping of detected trees; they are not guaranteed to match actual plantation blocks or planting rows.
Zone VARI summarizes ExG-selected pixels in the union of member tree detection boxes; pixels in overlapping boxes are counted once.
The optional P25 blanket-boost mode is a configurable spatial rule, not an agronomic diagnosis; validate its VARI gap cutoff for the imagery and management plan.
VARI is an RGB vegetation index, not a direct diagnosis of palm health or fertilizer requirement.
Fertilizer rates and prices are illustrative/configurable and are not agronomic recommendations.
Reported fertilizer boosts and totals are elemental Mg or N quantities; they are not converted to product mass.

Zone area is estimated from detected tree count × assumed spacing² (currently 9 m × 9 m per tree), unless measured per-zone or uniform areas are supplied. Missed detections affect the estimate; it is not a geospatial area measurement.

field_wide_npk_baseline_comparison.scope: all recognized recorded fertilizer-history products compared with the configured elemental baseline; dose-based annual use

calculation_steps: Margin factor = 1 + (15.00% ÷ 100) = 1 + 0.1500 = 1.1500; 1 represents the original 100% budget, and the added fraction is the allowed margin.
Allowed annual spend = Rp5,000,000 × 1.1500 = Rp5,750,000.
Reserve selected zone Mg + Urea whole-bag cost = Rp600,000.
NPK budget remaining = Rp5,750,000 − Rp600,000 = Rp5,150,000.
Baseline blend = 8.673118 bags/ha × 1.000000 ha = 8.673118 exact farm bags; buy ceil(...) = 9 bag(s).
Affordable NPK bags = floor(Rp5,150,000 ÷ Rp740,000/bag) = 6 full bag(s).
The baseline needs 9 full bag(s), above the 6 affordable; keep 1.00× because the nutrient baseline cannot be reduced.
Baseline plus zone products cost Rp7,260,000, exceeding the allowed Rp5,750,000.
budget_cap.status: baseline blend alone exceeds budget cap; baseline protected

age_based_npk_product_target.formula: baseline blend bags/ha = max(elemental N/P/K baseline ÷ elemental N/P/K per bag); baseline blend kg/tree/year = baseline blend kg/ha/year × farm ha ÷ detected trees; base-dose units/tree/application = baseline blend kg/tree/year ÷ (2 kg × applications/year); applied multiplier = Commonize age factor when enabled, otherwise 1.00; adjusted dose = base-dose units × applied multiplier × 2 kg

calculation_steps: Margin factor = 1 + (15.00% ÷ 100) = 1 + 0.1500 = 1.1500; 1 represents the original 100% budget, and the added fraction is the allowed margin.

Baseline blend = 7.333333 bags/ha × 1.000000 ha = 7.333333 exact farm bags; buy ceil(...) = 8 bag(s).
Affordable NPK bags = floor(Rp5,150,000 ÷ Rp630,000/bag) = 8 full bag(s).
Extra bag capacity above baseline = 8 affordable bags − 7.333333 exact baseline bags = 0.666667 bag(s).
Affordable increase fraction = 0.666667 extra bags ÷ 7.333333 baseline bags = 0.090909 (9.09% above baseline).

Maximum affordable multiplier = 1.00 baseline + 0.090909 increase = 1 + (8 ÷ 7.333333 − 1) = 1.090909×. At this multiplier, baseline 7.333333 × 1.090909 = 8.000000 bags, which equals the 8 affordable whole-bag limit.
Applied multiplier = min(Commonize 2.000000×, max(1.00×, 1.090909×)) = 1.090909×.
At 1.090909×: ceil(7.333333 × 1.090909) = 8 NPK bag(s); combined whole-bag cost = Rp5,640,000.
age_budget_cap.status: age multiplier reduced to fit budget cap

formulas.annual_product_kg_per_farm: dosePerTree kg/tree/application × fertilizerHistory.freq applications/year × detected tree count
formulas.annual_product_kg_per_ha: annual product kg per farm ÷ farm areaHa
formulas.bags_per_ha_year: annual product kg/ha/year ÷ bagKg; derived for reference, not entered by the farmer
formulas.elemental_supply: annual product kg/ha/year × (label guarantee % ÷ 100) × oxide-to-element factor; N factor=1
formulas.elemental_gap: max(0, baseline elemental kg/ha/year − total recognized recorded fertilizer supply kg/ha/year)
formulas.bags_to_buy: ceil(product needed kg ÷ bag size kg)

combined_fertilizer_calculations.scope_note: Field-wide standalone top-ups close the configured NPK baseline gap. Zone VARI boosts are separate additional zone calculations already derived from confidence, VARI, zone area, and configured Mg/N rates. They are stored together here for review but are not automatically added or netted against each other; check for overlap before deciding field application quantities.
